description: Java class implementing a FreeMarker transform for formatting currency amounts based on locale and ISO codes, used within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: OfbizCurrencyTransform
classes.description: Implements a FreeMarker TemplateTransformModel to format currency amounts dynamically based on configuration and locale.

methods.name: getArg
methods.description: Retrieves a string argument from the provided map of arguments, handling different TemplateScalarModel types.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Retrieves a BigDecimal amount from the arguments map, accommodating different input object types for robustness.

methods.name: getInteger
methods.description: Retrieves an Integer argument from the map, handling various numeric object types for flexibility.
